data.sub: Delhi ke cafe mein 22 varshiya yuvti se gangrape ka aarop.
data.asar: Suraksha par bada sawal, aisi ghatnayein sharmnaak hain.
data.caption:
Delhi ke ek cafe se samne aayi behad sharmnaak khabar.

• Cafe mein kaam karne wali yuvti se gangrape
• Shrab party ke baad di gayi ghatna ko anjam
• 2 mahilaon samet 3 aaropi ki hui giraftari

Aisi khabrein dil dahla deti hain.

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega.
